text:
ITEM 1 | Shredded orange carrot strands, bright orange with thin matchstick cut, piled loosely on the left side of the plate over greens, about 6 cm across, low height about 1 cm, matte and moist, sitting on leafy greens | 25
ITEM 2 | Dark green leafy vegetables (spinach-like leaves), crinkled and glossy with slight moisture, spread across the upper left quadrant, about 9 cm across, flat layer about 1 cm thick, partly under the carrot shreds | 30
ITEM 3 | Sliced pale green cucumber rounds and wedges, translucent edges with light green flesh, pale and slightly glossy, arranged at the top left, about 6 cm across, about 1 cm thick | 20
ITEM 4 | Broccoli florets, dark green with tight bumpy clusters, slightly glossy, grouped at top right and center, each floret about 2-3 cm across, about 2 cm tall, sitting beside the leafy greens | 45
ITEM 5 | Crumbly white soft mass, off-white with irregular curds and small pieces, no browning, moist-looking surface, piled in the right center covering about 8 cm by 7 cm, about 2.5 cm tall, does not hold a firm shape | 110
ITEM 6 | Whole and halved strawberries, bright red with seeded surface and green caps, glossy and juicy, cut into slices and halves, clustered in the lower center, each piece about 2-4 cm, about 1.5 cm tall | 50
ITEM 7 | Blueberries, dark blue-purple, small round and smooth with slight bloom, clustered in a loose heap in the lower center, each about 1 cm across, about 1.5 cm tall, next to strawberries | 30
ITEM 8 | Cherry tomato half, red with pale interior and visible seeds, glossy skin, sitting at the left edge beneath the carrots, about 2.5 cm across | 10
